containers.name: tmp
command: MYSQL_PWD="$DB_PASSWORD" mysql --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --table -h mysql -u"$DB_USERNAME" victoryfairy -e "UPDATE games SET game_status_id = (SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM game_statuses WHERE name = 'IN_PROGRESS') s), home_score = 0, away_score = 0, current_inning = 1, inning_half = 0, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE naver_game_id IN ('DEMO1110LGOB02026','DEMO1110HHKT02026','DEMO1110SKNC02026','DEMO1110LTWO02026','DEMO1110SSHT02026') AND game_status_id = (SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM game_statuses WHERE name = 'SCHEDULED') s2); SELECT g.naver_game_id, s.name status FROM games g JOIN game_statuses s ON s.id = g.game_status_id WHERE g.naver_game_id IN ('DEMO1110LGOB02026','DEMO1110HHKT02026','DEMO1110SKNC02026','DEMO1110LTWO02026','DEMO1110SSHT02026');"
